summary: Planning-only split before coding: I09b is in-progress with two pending B3 children. I09b1 delivers the running authenticated socket invitation service with the reusable durable ordered ingress/execution/outcome/publication path; I09b2 delivers native Accept/Decline/in-slot Reinvite, volatile ordered recovery and the two-normal-APK journey on that same service. Inspection confirms I09a supplies only account HTTP creation/read surfaces, with no game inbox/stream/publication worker or socket client yet. Original I09b outcome/checks and I09 parent are preserved. No runtime/build/test-input change, product scenario pass, review or release-gate claim; next fresh selection is I09b1.
selectionReason: Clean master/index at the supplied commit agrees with active D-304 authorization, reviewed B1/B2 and no actionable finding. I09a is implemented, making I09b the earliest ready task. Its first full game socket/durable server path plus native FIFO/recovery and two-device UI integration is too broad for one bounded implementation unit; split by running service capability then native delivery, not per-layer certification. Both children retain ordinary recovery/data-integrity checks and all existing scope; no further qualification children or reviews are added. This unit runs only the existing state/transition/selection guards and a read-only source/coverage/owned-path audit; unchanged product inputs justify no build/device/full-suite rerun.

planning.dependencies: I09b1 depends on implemented I09a, I09b2 depends on I09b1; neither depends on open I09b/I09 or later preparation/start tasks. I09b1 is a complete service path implementing actual invitation decisions, not an unserviced inbox scaffold. I09b2 is the complete native delivery/recovery/journey, reusing and extending it. Later I09b and I09 closure units reconcile exact child records/current inputs and only missing affected integration under D-307; independent B3 review remains after I09-I12 together.

retainedObligations: All four original I09b checks and its outcome remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The two children divide execution ownership, not scope: shared canonical envelopes/ordinals, authenticated socket/HTTP privacy/applicability, FIFO admission/durable receipts/dedup, atomic lowest-pending execution/outcomes/revisions/outbox, worker startup/reload/close, stream fencing, native ordered recovery and actual two-APK decisions remain required.

Reuse request_identity and ServiceRuntime writer fencing; extend worker composition so the new game workers do not replace reset-mail readiness/recovery. The existing attachWorker method currently stores one callback pair; integrate multiple implemented workers rather than silently dropping one. This is an evidenced integration seam for I09b1, not an independently filed defect in the still-unimplemented capability.

Initial game+first invitation is the existing account HTTP exception. Existing-game decisions/Reinvite use only the shared ordered socket/processor. Same-attempt original outcomes remain recoverable after Reinvite without installing stale snapshots. Decline preserves the inviter lobby; Accept is not Ready/start; no presence gate, mutual contacts, automatic expiry, replacement game or invented lifecycle policy.

I13/I14 extend this same processor/queue/recovery; no competing queue, outgoing journal, disclosure side channel, sequence reconstruction or execution-time reset fence. I28/I31 retain T-681 rematch/combined metadata and I26 full-tree recovery.

I34 retains full-suite/deferred infrastructure and combined scenarios, I35 compatibility and I36/B8 all interfaces/orientations against mocks. No external gate, authorization, grants, exact high model or runner configuration changes. No subagent, new loop, deployment, paid resource or UI-document publication.
